name: Self-Host Studio Video
description: Self-hosted video processing with FFmpeg and Whisper STT

shs_create_video.description: Create video from scenes containing images, video clips, and audio tracks. Supports Ken Burns effects, Whisper-powered subtitles, and scene grouping to pair images with audio per scene (audio drives duration).

record_id.title: Record ID
record_id.description: Custom ID to track this job (returned in webhook callback)

movie_id.title: Movie ID
movie_id.description: Custom identifier for this video project

client_data.title: Client Data
client_data.description: Custom data returned in webhook callback

subtitles_captions.title: Captions
subtitles_captions.description: Array of timed captions with start, end, and text

subtitles_src.title: Subtitle File URL
subtitles_src.description: URL to SRT or VTT subtitle file

subtitles_text.title: Subtitle Text
subtitles_text.description: Plain text to display as subtitles (auto-timed to audio duration)

subtitles_model.title: Transcription Model
subtitles_model.description: Whisper model for speech recognition. Larger models are more accurate but slower.

subtitles_backend.title: Transcription Engine
subtitles_backend.description: Whisper backend. Faster-Whisper transcribes about 2.3x quicker on CPU; OpenAI Whisper is the original and needs PyTorch.

subtitles_font_color.title: Font Color
subtitles_font_color.description: Subtitle text color. Use color name (white, yellow) or hex (#FFFFFF).

subtitles_background_color.title: Background Color
subtitles_background_color.description: Subtitle background color. Use hex with alpha (#00000080 for semi-transparent black).

subtitles_highlight_color.title: Highlight Color
subtitles_highlight_color.description: Word highlight color for karaoke style. Use color name (yellow) or hex (#FFFF00).

subtitles_outline_color.title: Outline Color
subtitles_outline_color.description: Text outline color. Use color name (black) or hex (#000000).

subtitles_max_words_per_phrase.title: Max Words Per Line
subtitles_max_words_per_phrase.description: Maximum words shown per subtitle line

subtitles_edge_padding.title: Edge Padding
subtitles_edge_padding.description: Screen margin from edge in pixels

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Video scenes containing visual and audio elements

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional label for this scene (e.g. Intro, Main Content, Outro)

type.title: Scene Type
type.description: Static scene renders as-is. Scene group expands via circular stacks.

repeat.title: Scene Count
repeat.description: Number of scene groups to produce. Each iteration pulls 'count' items from each element's src array.

subtitles_narration_texts.title: Narration Texts
subtitles_narration_texts.description: Reference text per item_group iteration for Whisper forced alignment. Worker pulls 1 per group via circular stack.

subtitles_font_family.title: Font Family
subtitles_font_family.description: Override default subtitle font. Leave empty to use default.

subtitles_font_size.title: Font Size
subtitles_font_size.description: Override default font size. 0 = use default.

subtitles_font_color.title: Font Color
subtitles_font_color.description: Override default font color. Leave empty for default.

subtitles_background_color.title: Background Color
subtitles_background_color.description: Override default background color. Leave empty for default.

subtitles_highlight_color.title: Highlight Color
subtitles_highlight_color.description: Override default highlight color. Leave empty for default.

subtitles_outline_color.title: Outline Color
subtitles_outline_color.description: Override default outline color. Leave empty for default.

subtitles_outline_width.title: Outline Width
subtitles_outline_width.description: Override default outline width. 0 = use default.

subtitles_shadow_offset.title: Shadow Offset
subtitles_shadow_offset.description: Override default shadow offset. -1 = use default.

subtitles_max_words_per_phrase.title: Max Words Per Line
subtitles_max_words_per_phrase.description: Override default max words per line. 0 = use default.

subtitles_edge_padding.title: Edge Padding
subtitles_edge_padding.description: Override default edge padding. -1 = use default.

duration.title: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Scene duration. Use -1 for auto (sum of element durations)

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: Visual and audio elements in this scene

src.title: Source URL
src.description: URL to the file. Supports http/https URLs. For images: jpg, png, webp. For video: mp4, webm. For audio: mp3, wav, m4a.

start.title: Start Time (seconds)
start.description: When element appears in scene (coming soon)

horizontal_position.title: Horizontal Position
horizontal_position.description: Horizontal placement when padding. Default: center

vertical_position.title: Vertical Position
vertical_position.description: Vertical placement when padding. Default: middle

width.title: Width
width.description: Element width in pixels. Only used when resize=custom. Other modes auto-detect from source.

height.title: Height
height.description: Element height in pixels. Only used when resize=custom. Other modes auto-detect from source.

resize.title: Resize Mode
resize.description: How to fit element in frame. Custom uses width/height; others auto-scale source to frame.

z_index.title: Layer (Z-Index)
z_index.description: Layer order (-99 to 99, higher = on top)

zoom_start.title: Zoom Start
zoom_start.description: Starting zoom level. 1.0 = no zoom, >1 = zoomed in. Use with zoom_end for custom animations, or alone for static zoom (enables panning).

zoom_end.title: Zoom End
zoom_end.description: Ending zoom level. 1.0 = no zoom, >1 = zoomed in. Same as zoom_start for static zoom, different for animated zoom.

pan.title: Pan Direction
pan.description: Ken Burns pan effect - camera pans in specified direction

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Audio volume multiplier. 0 = mute, 1 = original level, 2 = double volume

seek.title: Seek (Start Offset)
seek.description: Start offset within file in seconds (coming soon)

count.title: Count per Group
count.description: Items to pull from src array per scene group iteration. Only used when parent scene is a item_group. Ignored for static scenes.

durations.title: Durations
durations.description: Pre-computed durations in seconds, parallel to src array. Mapped from TTS step's duration_seconds output. If present, worker skips ffprobe. Circular-stacked alongside src.

width.title: Resolution
width.description: Video dimensions. Pick a preset or enter custom values.

framerate.title: Frame Rate
framerate.description: Frames per second. 24 = cinematic, 30 = standard, 60 = smooth motion

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Encoding quality. Higher = better quality but larger file and slower render

filename.title: Output Filename
filename.description: Custom filename for the output video (without extension). Leave empty for auto-generated name.

draft.title: Draft Mode
draft.description: Quick low-quality preview. Use for testing before final render.

default_duration.title: Duration (fallback)
default_duration.description: Duration for elements that don't specify their own. Each element can override this.

default_zoom_start.title: Zoom Start (fallback)
default_zoom_start.description: Default starting zoom level for elements. 1.0 = no zoom, >1 = zoomed in. Use >1 to provide pan headroom.

default_zoom_end.title: Zoom End (fallback)
default_zoom_end.description: Default ending zoom level for elements. Set equal to start for static zoom, or different for animated zoom.

smoothness.title: Smoothness
smoothness.description: Zoom animation smoothness. Higher = smoother but slower render.

padding_color.title: Padding Color
padding_color.description: Background color for letterboxing. Use color name (black, white) or hex (#000000).

horizontal_position.title: Horizontal Position (fallback)
horizontal_position.description: Default horizontal position for elements that don't specify their own.

vertical_position.title: Vertical Position (fallback)
vertical_position.description: Default vertical position for elements that don't specify their own.

resize.title: Default Resize Mode
resize.description: Default resize mode for elements that don't specify their own.

output_per_group.title: Output Per Group
output_per_group.description: Output separate per-group videos instead of one concatenated video.

scenes.title: Scenes & Elements
scenes.description: Build your video with scenes containing images, video clips, and audio

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: Fallback values for elements and subtitle defaults. Each scene and element can override these.
